workouts.name: Monday Full Body
workouts.notes:
Monday full body. Compound-first, legs-biased. 3 rounds · 45s work · 20s rest · 2 min break between supersets.

Group 1 — Lower: quads · hamstrings · glutes · adductors
Group 2 — Upper: chest · lats · shoulders · triceps · biceps
Group 3 — Core: anti-rotation · rectus abdominis · obliques

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squats
exercises.notes: Bar on traps, chest up, knees track toes, drive through heels

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlifts
exercises.notes: Hip hinge, soft knee, bar stays close, feel hamstring stretch at bottom

exercises.name: DB Reverse Lunges
exercises.notes: Step back, front shin vertical, lower back knee toward floor

exercises.name: DB Hip Thrusts
exercises.notes: Upper back on bench edge, chin tucked, squeeze glutes hard at top

exercises.name: DB Bench Press
exercises.notes: Shoulder blades pinched back, lower to mid-chest, press straight up

exercises.name: BB Bent-over Row
exercises.notes: Hinge 45°, pull bar to lower ribs, lead with elbows, control the descent

exercises.name: DB Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Core tight, press straight up, avoid flaring ribs at lockout

exercises.name: Renegade Row
exercises.notes: Plank position, row one side at a time, resist rotation with hips

exercises.name: Push-up to T-Rotation
exercises.notes: Push-up then rotate to side plank, arm toward ceiling, control the twist

exercises.name: Plank Up-Downs
exercises.notes: From plank lower to forearms one arm at a time, keep hips level

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.notes: Slow and controlled, elbow to opposite knee, full rotation each side

workouts.name: Wednesday Push + Core
workouts.notes:
Wednesday after aerial class. Push emphasis, triceps, shoulders, core. 3 rounds · 45s work · 20s rest · 90s break.

Group 1 — Push: chest · anterior deltoid · triceps
Group 2 — Isolation: triceps · lateral deltoid · core
Group 3 — Abs: anti-extension · obliques · hip flexors

exercises.name: DB Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: 30-45° incline, lower dumbbells to chest, press up and slightly in

exercises.name: DB Chest Press
exercises.notes: Flat back, dumbbells meet at top, controlled eccentric 2-3 seconds

exercises.name: DB Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Standing or seated, brace core, avoid arching lower back at lockout

exercises.name: Pike Push-ups
exercises.notes: Hips high, lower forehead toward floor, elbows track out at 45°

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.notes: Hands on bench behind you, elbows point back not out, lower 90°

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raises
exercises.notes: Slight forward lean, lead with elbows, stop at shoulder height, slow down

exercises.name: Tricep Overhead Extension
exercises.notes: One DB overhead, elbows in, lower behind head, extend fully

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.notes: Shoulders over wrists, drive knees to chest, keep hips level

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Lower back pressed to floor, arms overhead, legs low and straight

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.notes: Slow and deliberate, full rotation, keep lower back flat

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.notes: Legs together, lower slowly without letting back arch off floor

workouts.name: Friday Legs + Glutes
workouts.notes:
Friday legs and glutes focus. 4 rounds · 45s work · 20s rest · 2 min break between supersets.

Group 1 — Squat pattern: quads · glutes · adductors
Group 2 — Hinge + glute isolation: hamstrings · glutes · posterior chain
Group 3 — Isolation finisher: glutes · calves · abductors

exercises.name: BB Back Squats
exercises.notes: Bar on traps, depth to parallel or below, drive knees out on ascent

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
exercises.notes: Rear foot elevated, torso upright, lower until front thigh is parallel

exercises.name: Goblet Squats
exercises.notes: DB at chest, squat wide, elbows push knees out at bottom

exercises.name: DB Lateral Lunges
exercises.notes: Step wide to one side, sit into hip, keep trailing leg straight

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlifts
exercises.notes: Bar or DBs, hip hinge, slight knee bend, feel hamstring stretch

exercises.name: BB Hip Thrusts
exercises.notes: Bar padded across hips, drive through heels, full glute squeeze at top

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL
exercises.notes: Hinge on one leg, other leg extends back, keep hips square

exercises.name: Good Mornings
exercises.notes: Bar on traps, soft knee, hinge forward until torso near parallel, squeeze up

exercises.name: Glute Kickbacks
exercises.notes: On all fours, drive heel to ceiling, squeeze glute at top, no hip rotation

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.notes: Full range of motion, pause at top and bottom, slow controlled tempo

exercises.name: Hip Abductions
exercises.notes: Side lying or standing with DB, lift leg to 45°, control the descent

workouts.name: Saturday Completion
workouts.notes:
Saturday after 30 min run. ~31 min. Completes weekly back, biceps, shoulder, and abs volume. No warmup — run covers it.

Group 1 — Back: lats · rhomboids · rear deltoid · traps
Group 2 — Biceps + Shoulders + Abs: biceps · lateral deltoid · rectus abdominis · obliques

exercises.name: BB Bent-over Row
exercises.notes: Hinge 45°, pull to lower ribs, elbows close to body, slow negative

exercises.name: Single-arm DB Row
exercises.notes: Knee and hand on bench, row to hip, full stretch at bottom

exercises.name: Prone Y Raises
exercises.notes: Face down, arms form Y overhead, lift with rear delts, thumbs up

exercises.name: DB Bicep Curls
exercises.notes: Elbows pinned at sides, full range, supinate at top, no swing

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.notes: Neutral grip, curl both arms simultaneously, control the descent

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raises
exercises.notes: Slight forward lean, lead with elbows, stop at shoulder height

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.notes: Slow and controlled, full elbow-to-knee rotation each rep

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.notes: Legs together, lower slowly, keep lower back pressed to floor

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.notes: Feet off floor, lean back 45°, rotate side to side with control
